candidates.description: This vector represents German spatial and directional prepositions.
This feature vector represents German adverbial and conjunctive connectors used for transition, qualification, and modification.
Common German verb and noun prefixes.
This feature vector represents common German grammatical words, prefixes, and high-frequency verbs.
These tokens represent German modal and auxiliary verbs, indicating necessity, ability, permission, or desire.
This feature activates on German prefixes, roots, and adjectives related to difference, distinction, and variety.
This feature vector activates on common roots, names, and demonyms of continents, countries, and major geographic regions.
This vector represents common prefixes and morphological roots across various European languages.
This vector activates for sanitation, hygiene, waste management, and related environmental maintenance terms across multiple languages.
This vector activates on various combinations of closing punctuation marks and sentence-ending delimiters.
